plan.budgetMeaning: Named spans plus unverified runtime reservations, not a measured peak or hard allocator bound
plan.semantics: Capacity-sentinel storage, not real model hidden states; conservative four-store/FFN-cache overlap, not the actual stage schedule
plan.actualCandidateSchedule: Self-attention uses four hidden stores; FFN normally uses one remaining hidden store. This diagnostic keeps all four while testing the FFN-down tile.

comparison.weightPreservationScope: One native F32 word per4096byte page plus exact tail, not a full-weight bit comparison
comparison.hiddenPreservationScope: Nonzero-filled capacity sentinels sampled per4096byte page plus tail; no payload hash and no real hidden meaning
